phases.description: Initialize project, set up Node.js and Express environment, and configure basic server structure.
Implement in-memory storage, develop CRUD API endpoints for notes, and ensure proper request handling.
Create unit and integration tests for API endpoints, test memory management and error handling.
Prepare codebase for deployment, include environment variables configuration and documentation.

top_risks.risk: Data loss due to in-memory storage.
top_risks.mitigation: Clearly communicate the limitation and ensure it is acceptable for the intended usage context.

top_risks.risk: System crashing due to a large number of notes because of memory limitations.
top_risks.mitigation: Set a reasonable limit for the number of notes and handle memory usage appropriately.

estimate.summary: The project requires a moderate effort to implement a simple notes API with Node.js and Express. The biggest cost driver is the core logic development, specifically the implementation of in-memory storage and thorough testing. Key assumptions include no need for persistent storage and minimal external service integration.
